task_completion.description: Create at least two physically enclosed spaces using at least three new wall segments.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for new wall lines in the 2D plan view that create distinct enclosed rectangular or polygonal areas (e.g., a walk-in cooler or lobby) separate from the main shell.

task_completion.description: Define and name at least four room zones and apply distinct floor treatments to at least three of them.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check for text labels in the 2D plan (e.g., 'Brand A Line', 'Driver Lobby') and different colors or textures applied to the floor areas of these zones in the 3D view.

task_completion.description: Furnish the facility with at least 6 cooking or cooling appliances.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify at least 6 3D models representing stoves, ovens, fryers, refrigerators, or freezers placed within the kitchen layout.

task_completion.description: Add at least 8 prep surfaces and 6 storage units.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count at least 8 work tables/counters and 6 shelving units, racks, or cabinets visible in the 2D plan or 3D rendering.

task_completion.description: Add at least 4 sanitation items (sinks, washbasins, or dishwashers).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Locate at least 4 sink-style or dishwasher models placed within the floor plan.

task_completion.description: Add at least two dimension lines across main prep aisles and save the layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least two measurement lines with numerical values (dimension lines) spanning the gaps between counters/walls in the 2D view, and evidence of the 'Save' action.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the 'Create walls' tool, dragging furniture from the catalog, or using the 'Create rooms' tool.

integrity.description: The agent did not use CLI scripts to bypass the design process.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal should not show execution of scripts that programmatically modify the .sh3d file; progress should be visible step-by-step in the GUI.

integrity.description: The layout is a custom design, not a pre-existing template.
integrity.visual_evidence: The placement of walls and furniture should reflect the specific requirements (e.g., 'Brand A Line') rather than looking like a default residential house.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The starter file 'ghost_kitchen_starter.sh3d' is actually a modified residential villa containing 48 existing walls and 10 pre-existing rooms (e.g., 'Bedroom', 'Living room'). The agent must add NEW walls (at least 3) and NEW named rooms (at least 4) on top of this existing structure to satisfy the task. The VLM should specifically look for the addition of commercial kitchen equipment (stainless steel tables, industrial sinks) which are not part of the residential starter file.
